title: Wilful violations; penalties.
bodyText: Unless otherwise provided herein, any person who knowingly, intentionally or wilfully violates any section of this chapter shall be guilty of a petty misdemeanor.
bodyHtml: [§576E-19]  Wilful violations; penalties.  Unless otherwise provided herein, any person who knowingly, intentionally or wilfully violates any section of this chapter shall be guilty of a petty misdemeanor. [L 1990, c 176, pt of §1]
